corrections_after_observed_failures: The first bridge logged the base-class selector while real players use the three-argument Humanoid override; both selectors now record their actual native trip selection.
Unconstrained pose matching could overrule the incident direction and choose a front brace for every direction. Incident direction now has priority within eligible trip clips.
The standalone solo partner cannot enter normal tactical command generation at the end of its trip. Its authored trip track is sampled directly instead.

The previous travel assertion required the generic forced walk (over 10 cm). It now requires a genuine native trip plus an observed support displacement over 4 cm; the original authored side step measured approximately 7.16 cm. The new directional test separately requires multiple protective sources.

An anatomical projection can leave an analytically reachable hand goal short. Constrained CCD refines that goal before the existing bounded rate controller. Joint limits, grip start below 10 cm, release at 23 cm and force cap 260 N remain intact.
F12 is the renderer global quit key. The match contact setup uses F2 instead, preserving the quit binding.

An LT trial legitimately lost reach after about 180 ms as ball assistance changed the stance. Reciprocal traction is checked during that actual LT attachment; the sustained-traction requirement is additionally checked after confirmed attachment in the separate H trial. Reach tolerances were not relaxed.

upstream_assets.historical_checker_without_flag: Reports intentionally adapted shader and three gameplay source modules; not used as the readiness gate.

sdk.transport: Official GitHub release downloads over verified TLS; SHA256 values record the downloaded archives. Debian toolchain packages were verified by APT.
sdk.runtime: Working portable DLLs reused; import archives generated with gendef/dlltool. Package test verifies all non-system transitive DLL imports.

limitations: Rendered validation uses native Linux with an SDL virtual Xbox controller. Windows was cross-compiled and packaged; no Windows GUI or physical Xbox hardware session was available.
The active balance model remains reduced and animation-guided; falling has bounded internal PD joint torques and ground-contact support. It is not a trained whole-body muscle policy.
The 18 native protective sources include mirrors. The 288 existing variants are procedural, not new rotoscoped motion captures.
Each articulated body has a local Bullet floor. Player interactions use native collisions, reciprocal impulses and bounded shirt traction, not one shared 22-body rigid world.
Collision volumes and cloth are approximations; arbitrary mesh triangle separation is not guaranteed.
